name: bench
//: The informational performance suite: never a gate, so the gate tiers reach only its format (cargo fmt, and shfmt over the harness scripts), lint (which compiles the benches, and shellchecks the harness scripts) and test (the harness scripts' offline input checks, which measure nothing). The bench* targets are what `just bench*` and the Performance workflow run. bench-cli and bench-instructions build the mock fixture themselves as a tool, so a fixture change does not select this project.

options.command: bash tools/coverage/shcov.sh run bench -- cargo nextest run -p llmlint-bench --locked

test.//: Offline: harness_inputs drives bench.sh and bench-instructions.sh up to their own hyperfine/valgrind check and profile.sh against stand-in cargo/samply, so a bad BENCH_* or PROFILE_* override is shown refused by name; nothing is built, timed or profiled.

bench.//: The forwarded arguments are Criterion's: `just bench <baseline> [options]` passes `--save-baseline <baseline>` and the options.

options.command: mkdir -p target/bench && cargo bench --locked --quiet -p llmlint-bench --bench engine_allocs > target/bench/allocs.md && cat target/bench/allocs.md

bench-allocs.//: Also written to target/bench/allocs.md, which the Performance workflow's report embeds (Nx's own run banners stay out of it). Redirected, then printed, rather than piped through tee, so a failed bench fails the target.
